_doc: Initial detector input for Roseville Creekview Phase 5 — fresh Nov 2025 issue. Tests live YELLOW V/L and HIGH top-taxpayer concentration.

value_to_lien_collapse.source: Roseville OS Series 2025 Nov 25 2025, appraisal as of 10/1/2025
value_to_lien_collapse._note: 4.03x is just above the yellow zone. Strong but not great. Note: market value of taxable property is from appraisal which models post-development value, so V/L could deteriorate if mb closings slip.

buildout_stalled.merchant_builder_status_detail: Phase 5 land sales to Expected Phase 5 Merchant Builders still pending closing as of Nov 2025; home closings to individual homeowners expected starting [late 2025/2026]
buildout_stalled._note: buildout_stalled detector should NOT fire on fresh issues. Only fire if 3+ years post-issuance with build-out still <50%.

top_taxpayer_concentration.source: OS — Master Developer still owns essentially all parcels pending merchant-builder closings
top_taxpayer_concentration._note: Detector should distinguish 'pre-buildout normal concentration' vs 'stalled concentration'. Suggested rule: fire on >50% concentration when also paired with buildout >3yr post-issuance OR delinquency >2%.

_notes: Fresh issue + 100% master-developer concentration triggers top_taxpayer_concentration. This is the calibration question — pre-buildout CFDs are inherently concentrated. The detector should either (a) auto-exclude all pre-buildout CFDs (which may be the right answer for retail HNW investors) or (b) defer firing until first stress signal.
